reviews.x: Great lather, amazing scent! I would recommend this soap to anyone looking for a great shave soap to try. It is only the second bay rum soap I have tried, but it beats the pants off of the Col. Conk's bay rum in the scent department.

reviews.t: Best shaving soap ever.  And it's made in America.  What else do you need?
reviews.x: This stuff is great.  I've been using Ogallala's shaving soap for a couple of weeks now, and I love it.  It's easy to lather, and the lather is rich, lubricates well, and smells fantastic.  It lathers as well or better than Taylor of Old Bond Street's shaving creams, and I think that's saying a lot.  My first shaving soap when I switched to traditional wet shaving was the Col. Conk Bay Rum, and the scent of this Ogallala is much more intense and far outlasts the former.  If you like bay rum and

I'm a long-time, repeat customer of this product.  I've tried others that worked okay but they didn't always whip up into a lasting foam or the scent was off-putting.  I tried John's product over five years ago and haven't looked back at any others even those given as gifts from family and friends.  To start, you need a good quality badger boar bristle brush.  This is to insure you don't lose bristles in your soap cup or have them on your face while trying to shave.  Soak the center of the brush

I have been trying Ogallala’s other products and honestly, I thought I was buying the hand soap as I already had an almost new shave soap I was using. It was a mistake that I am glad I made.  I like bay rum scents but a lot of them run too heavy or too light with certain scents. Ogallala’s scents are pretty equal all across the board. No one scent overpowers the other and they all seem to work together equally.  When I received this, I was using Taylor of Old Bond Street Sandalwood shave cream w

Classic barbershop clean shaved bay rum scent. A sweeter scent than many bay rums with notes of vanilla...I don't detect any cloves or cinnamon. Very thick protective lather; it works equally well face lathering or in a bowl. Doesn't matter if you use a boar or badger brush...the result is a great lather. The scent makes the morning shave a very pleasant, relaxing experience. You could use a bay rum, a vanilla, or a lime aftershave following your shave.

This stuff smells great! Frankly at first I couldn't get the lather right. It would be very light and fluffy and dissipate in a few seconds. Then I read up a little on it and other soaps like it and realized I needed a little more water and the big thing…. you have to REALLY whip it up. Once you get the water mixture right and the technique down, this stuff smells great when you're waking up in the morning and makes your face really slick for a great shave. I'll often just pick it up to smell it

This soap is one of the best I've tried. It goes on a bit like a paste, and has a couple of moisturizers, as well as glycerin. I would suggest it very highly for wet shavers. It has a nice spicy scent that fills the bathroom(nice guy smell), and I'm using an early 50's Old Spice mug with it. It originally sat a little high in the mug, but has since worn down through use to a snug fit. It works very well with a double edge razor, or even a cut-throat blade.

reviews.t: and he's extremely happy with it
reviews.x: My son became a proponent of the straight razor all of a sudden, but was using some overpriced fancy schmancy cream stuff from the shaving store, so I got him the "Kingsley Shave Soap Bowl with Lid Dark Wood" and a two pack of this lovely soap, and he's extremely happy with it.  He takes it with him whenever he goes anywhere overnight.  It smells really nice, I'm overly sensitive to synthetic fragrances, and this seems very natural to me.  He's been using it for a good while now, and has

I have tried many other soaps but this one beats them all. It lathers fast and extra foamy rather than watery -- especially with a good brush All of the Ogallala  products demonstrate consistent fragrance and quality --- they remind me of my Grandfather when I small them, so now that I am in my 70's I hope my Grand-kids like and remember the way I smell too.  Great products!

I absolutely love this shaving soap, by far the best smelling one I've ever used. It was a little large for my soap cup, so I just melted it and poured it in and let it settle. Builds a really great lather, I see some reviewers mentioning that it dries quick, and I noticed that a few times, but you just gotta add more water or work the lather a bit more. I noticed this soap takes a little more time to build a good lather than other soaps I've used. If there was one drawback to this, it's how qui

It was shipped the morning after I ordered. as far as the soap,We have very hard water but it produced a great smooth lather on my first tr with a 6 month old Escali brush..I had two days of growth so I decided to try it before I actually shaved. What I noticed after rinsing it off was how much it had softened my beard.Later that day i whipped up a great lather and had a great shave.  The puck is a full 4oz and  the quality is evident. I would guess that the two pucks  will last at least 4 month

The scent is great.  Beyond that the soap is only acceptable.  It is very fickle with the amount of water needed to make a lather.  Too much and it disappears on your face in a matter of seconds.  Too little water and you can't even begin to make it lather.  I know that's the case with any shave soap but this one seems to be overly picky.  I will experiment further with different brushes and a bowl lather instead of face lather before I retire it for good.

The price is great. The soap is good, not great, but good quality. Loads on the brush fine. Leathers fine. Provides good protection when shaving. But the scent, at least to me, is awful. I had to throw it away. However,  many people like it so if you are in that number, this is a nice soap at a great price.

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for
reviews.x: The aroma is outstanding works as a air freshener in the bath area, good lather, great shave, love it and recommend if you like Bay Rum.
My husband loves this stuff, to be honest I do too! It smells wonderful for sure! It makes his skin soft too. Great value great price.
Smells great. Lather wears out me gets dry pretty quick.

So I bought this back in July 2012 and I like it still so far. I don't shave very often since my beard growth isn't crazy nor is it thick like some others, so I haven't made much of a dent in one of the pucks lol So I can't really compare it to many other soaps since I'm relatively new to wet shaving. But the scent for this is awesome out of the box! Hell, even through the box. When I received it in the mail, I could pretty much smell what it was XD But mind you, it's actually not THAT strong. W

reviews.t: Wonderful scent! You do need a really wet shaving ...
reviews.x: Wonderful scent!  You do need a really wet shaving brush and a little effort (like whipping up scrambled eggs) but it lathers just fine.  I sometimes get the lather ready for my husband while he's finishing his shower (can't help it, the scent is intoxicating) and it goes on nicely, to help him get that nice close shave!  Very reasonable price, too.

reviews.t: Gives a close shave and smells great!
reviews.x: Lathers well and the scent is the old timey smell of Bay Rum. The large pucks make it worth while to purchase and they will fit into any size shave cup because this product is glycerin based and a few seconds in a microwave will make it pourable or plyable into your cup. This is my first choice when it comes to shave soap.

This soap is awesome!  I really like the bay rum scents and this fit the ideal mold for me.  I do not wear after shave or colognes so the residual scent left behind from this soap is plenty for me. Really builds a rich, thick lather too.  I intend to buy this soap as long as they will make it. Great stuff!

reviews.t: Now this is a real Awesome soap
reviews.x: I have several Bay Rum shaving soaps, but this is the king of them all.  Honestly it is in the my top five favorite shaving soaps for performance and scent.  Great value as well.  If you are on the fence about Bay Rum.... This soap will make you a fan!!

I got these to give as gifts but I ended up trying one of them. Iam glad I did . This product lathers well and gives a close shave. It has a plesent Bay Rum aroma. I shave with a straight razor and I found this soap to work well for me.

I have been shaving with brush & lather for 50 years.  This product is by far the best I have ever used; fragrant and easy to apply.  It will liquefy in a few seconds in a microwave and pour into any-shape cup. Highly recommended!

reviews.t: Great smell and a thick lather that gives a smooth ...
reviews.x: Great smell and a thick lather that gives a smooth shave . I love this soap. This was my first use of this shave soap and it is very rich in smell and lather. I would recommend this to anyone who wet shaves. Thank's

Hands-down my favorite shaving cream ever. Lathers up great, smells great, goes a long way. It may seem expensive, but when you factor the quality and how long it lasts......it is actually economical.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the soap's scent, describing it as great, spicy, and a classic bay rum aroma.
Most reviewers report that it lathers easily and produces a rich, thick, protective lather.
A few reviewers note the lather is finicky about water and can dry or dissipate quickly if not whipped up properly.
Some reviewers find the scent off-putting or awful, though others love it.
Several reviewers are repeat or long-time customers who consider it the best shaving soap they have tried.
